items.title: Pie Stall Coloring Illustration
items.alt: Black-and-white bake-sale stall with two pies, a bakery box, bunting and a blank hanging sign.
items.description: Black-and-white bake-sale stall with two pies, a bakery box, bunting and a blank hanging sign. Add a short classroom message to the blank sign and color the awning for a personal activity.
